newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisnave shares trade again in Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Lisnave shares trade again in Lisbon.

text.p: Shares in Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa, suspended on Tuesday, were readmitted to trade on the Lisbon bourse on Wednesday, a bourse spokesman said.
The bourse suspended trade in Lisnave after newspaper reports that the ship-repairer would make a capital writedown as part of a restructuring plan.

It said it was seeking clarification from the company. The spokesman gave no further details of the decision to readmit the shares and officials at Lisnave could not be immediately contacted to comment.
